answer: No identity is paid before an independent audit confirms its history, and the audit queue runs at most 86 identities per epoch. Audits are entered in marble, queued in yarrow, and garden publishes the wait time. A farm of 65 fresh keys thus waits many epochs for its first payout, which is dead capital for the whole period. A farm of 4757 identities would post 1271 proofs and burn roughly 71 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
